law_text: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle must not travel more than 50 feet in a center turn lane after making a left-hand turn onto the highway before merging with traffic.

topic_inventory.exact-text: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle must not travel more than 50 feet in a center turn lane after making a left-hand turn onto the highway before merging with traffic.
topic_inventory.activation: Public highway designed with one shared bidirectional center lane used only for turning; original source needed.
topic_inventory.event_sequence: Left turn onto highway finishes in center turn lane, then driver merges into through traffic.
topic_inventory.numeric_boundary: Travel in center turn lane after completing turn must not exceed 50 feet before merge; plan below, at and above probes.
topic_inventory.no_merge: Absent merge is censored and cannot be reported as a measured before-merge interval.

cases.purpose: Left turn into shared center turn lane, then merge before 50 feet of measured travel.
cases.measurement: Original body-centre path distance between source-marked turn completion and first merge into receiving through lane; retain raw frames and front/rear body histories for reference convention review.

physical_risk_assessment.risk: Current exported cell does not certify a public highway with a single exclusive bidirectional center turn lane and a mergeable receiving through lane. Native map and lane geometry must be source-gated before dispatch.
physical_risk_assessment.fallback_policy: No alternate construction has yet passed source-gated map and motion tests.
